name: storerate
description: StoreRate - store rating platform (FullStack Intern Coding Challenge)

scripts.setup: npm install && node scripts/ensure-env.js && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run db:reset
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run preview"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
